keyword: how many times has tiger woods been arrested
claims: As of March 28, 2026, Tiger Woods has been arrested twice on suspicion of driving under the influence (DUI).
Tiger Woods's first arrest on suspicion of DUI occurred in May 2017 in Jupiter, Florida.
In the May 2017 incident, Tiger Woods was found asleep at the wheel.
Tiger Woods pleaded guilty to reckless driving for the May 2017 incident.
Tiger Woods's second arrest on suspicion of DUI occurred on March 27, 2026, in Florida.
The March 27, 2026 arrest followed a rollover car crash.
In the May 2017 incident, Tiger Woods was found asleep in his running car.
The May 2017 incident was attributed to a mix of pain medications.
Tiger Woods entered a diversion program for the May 2017 incident.
In the March 27, 2026 arrest, Tiger Woods was arrested for DUI with property damage and refusal to submit to a test.
The March 27, 2026 incident involved Tiger Woods's vehicle rolling over on Jupiter Island.
Tiger Woods was involved in a serious car accident in November 2009 in Florida.
Tiger Woods was involved in a serious car accident in February 2021 in California.
CBS Sports, ESPN, and NPR state that the 2017 and 2026 incidents resulted in formal arrests.
